REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 46/R&A Dated: 07th August, 2026
The final result of Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 (advertised vide
PHC/01/2025) was notified vide Court Notice No. 12/R&A dated 10.03.2026. Out of 171 finally
selected candidates, the following 07 candidates have neither joined to the post of Regular Mazdoor
nor prayed for extension of joining time before the stipulated last date of joining to the post of
Regular Mazdoor as per the issued appointment letter, i.e., till 16.04.2026:
It is hereby informed to all concerned that the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to cancel the
selection/appointment of the said 07 candidates to the post of Regular Mazdoor under Regular
Mazdoor Recruitment Examination 2025.
By order of the Court
Sd/-Rupesh Deo
Registrar General
